Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Civil Surgeon cum Chief Medical Office Saraikela Kharsawan Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview is 25th September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue within the reporting time.

faq.answer: The reporting time for the walk-in interview is from 11:00 AM to 02:00 PM on 25th September 2026.

faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree from a recognized Medical Council to be eligible for these positions.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all candidates applying for these posts is 60 years.

faq.answer: The salary for the Doctor (Empanelled) post is Rs. 1,400.00/- per working day, with a maximum of 26 working days per month.
